## Passages
RESULT [weeds]: Detection latency about 118 ms on a Pi 5 and weed elimination of 97% in Vancouver and 96% in Arusha, despite a detection mAP of only 0.32. The robot moves at 5 cm/s and covers 0.01-0.03 ha per day. These figures come from a news summary; the journal page returned 403.
US [weeds]: Close to Harry's ESP32/Raspberry Pi laser car. At slow speed with repeated looks, high kill rates are reachable with a weak detector, so what matters in the field is recall at the robot's speed and the dwell-time loop more than holdout mAP50-95.
